meta.title: Ondra Life & Rhythm
meta.description: Her own day, plus how much strength she has left. The life layer runs six activities (studying, reading, videos, diary, spacing out, chatting in a group) over interests tagged focus, relax or create: doing one raises its weight, untouched interests decay by a half-life, ten percent of draws explore a new interest, a low mood biases toward relaxing ones, and notes are either long-term memory candidates or one-day working notes. The rhythm layer integrates energy in five-minute slices: +0.2 per minute awake, +1 in deep sleep or after midnight, a natural cap of 60, a 0.1 per minute fall from anything hand-fed above it, frozen during an emergency stop, and a wake-up buffer that clears the moment it is taken. One clock-driven tick, nothing resident, no messages, no memory writes.
